title: Seat paired floating blind-mate coolant ports on a cold compute tray
instruction: Push the unpowered tray straight into the manifold until both coolant ports seat, then release it.
context: Tests simultaneous blind-mate seating on a liquid-cooled AI compute tray.
setup: Cold bench surrogate with tray datum (306, -79) mm, 48 mm port pitch, 38 mm insertion, 2.2 mm starting lateral mismatch, and paired spring-floating receivers with ±4 mm physical travel. Blue supply and orange return guide jaws.
scoring: 0.25 per receiver within 0.5 mm laterally after 20 mm insertion. 0.75 for both and a depth gap no larger than 0.5 mm. Full credit after one second released at seat. Contact with the float travel limit invalidates the trial.
reset_notes: Retract and square the tray, center both receivers and confirm initial offset before the next trial.
fidelity: Original guide-jaw surrogate based on NVIDIA floating blind mates. Pitch, float, pin envelope and insertion loads are provisional. Demonstrates dual self-alignment on a dry, pressure-free fixture.
